textures.name: Melody + accompaniment
textures.function: One instrument sings, others provide rhythmic/harmonic support

textures.name: Tremolo atmosphere
textures.function: Strings tremolo; melody in winds or solo string over the texture

textures.name: Chorale
textures.function: Block chords in all parts; homophonic; hymn-like

textures.name: Dialogue
textures.function: Melody passes phrase-by-phrase between instruments or instrument groups

textures.name: Divine moment
textures.function: High strings only (pp/ppp); low instruments tacet; one sustained chord

textures.name: Unison/octave tutti
textures.function: All instruments on the same melody in unison or octaves

textures.name: Vln I, Vln II, Vla, Vc, Cb
textures.function: Foundation; carry melody, accompaniment, and tremolo

textures.name: 2 Hn, 2 Tpt, 3 Tbn (late works)
textures.function: Distance, weight, chorale; trombones in late symphonies only
